newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates down on lack of borrowing.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates down on lack of borrowing.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed lower on Monday on lack of borrowing interest and dealers said rates were likely to remain steady to weak on Tuesday.
Overnight funds opened at 16 percent and soon scaled up to 18 percent, but scanty borrowing interest at these levels forced lenders to bring down their offers, one dealer said.
He said the market closed at around the 12 percent level.
Dealers said rates were expected to stay steady on Tuesday as no major inflow or outflow was foreseen.
